decision: Fair DeepPBS-vs-v24 on the primary 291 benchmark was NOT completed; accepted as a documented limitation.
reason: Retraining DeepPBS on the train_v22 split (to avoid leakage) crashed repeatedly in DeepPBS's multiflow env (torch segfault during training; run.sh permission error; float32 JSON bug at scoring). 3 detached attempts failed.
